basics.name: Dmitry Rybalka
basics.label: Lead Product Designer
basics.summary: Product design leader with 15+ years of hands-on experience creating B2B/B2C digital products across FinTech, marketplaces, classifieds, HealthTech, leasing, and e-commerce. Experienced in leading full-cycle design from discovery and hypothesis framing to delivery, connecting user needs, business context, UX research, design systems, and product metrics.

work.name: Larixon Classifieds
work.summary: International classifieds group with market-leading platforms across Cyprus, Mongolia, Tajikistan, Trinidad and Tobago, and Jamaica. Project markets include Cyprus, Mongolia, Tajikistan, Trinidad and Tobago, and Jamaica.
highlights: Developed the design function across Product Design, DesignOps, Design Systems, and UX Research.
Scaled the team to 7+ Product Designers and 1 UX Research Lead across 8+ product verticals.
Built the Design System from 0 to 1: Web/App, DSO roles, governance, and maturity tracker.
Launched UX Research from 0 to 1 across Cyprus, Mongolia, and Tajikistan.
Introduced AI-assisted workflows for discovery, ideation, and documentation.

work.name: Raiffeisen Bank International
work.summary: Banking, trading, investment, leasing, B2B marketplace, CRM, and internal tooling work across Raiffeisen Bank and Raiffeisen Leasing.
highlights: Led UX for a professional trading terminal serving 500+ institutional clients.
Defined product design strategy across 5+ investment-product tools.
Mentored 5 designers, conducted design reviews, and supported hiring across 2 product teams.
Designed a B2B leasing marketplace and modular CRM for 19 role types and 350+ sales reps.
Cut offer generation time from 12 minutes to 2 minutes.
Increased process automation from 10% to 90%.

work.name: Yandex.Market
work.summary: Large-scale e-commerce marketplace work across analytics products, seller-facing tools, vendor onboarding workflows, and product taxonomy.
highlights: Led UX for a large-scale analytics platform used by product and category teams.
Reduced vendor onboarding time from 90 days to 1 day.
Designed seller tools adopted by 35,000+ marketplace vendors.
Improved product taxonomy and categorization for 57M+ SKUs covering 890 marketplace categories.

work.name: GdeMaterial
work.summary: Early-stage DIY marketplace for construction and home improvement materials.
highlights: Led UX for a DIY marketplace startup with 500+ suppliers and 2,000 B2B clients.
Increased conversion from 0.5% to 1.6%.
Launched product, checkout, and logistics workflows.

work.name: Medesk Ltd.
work.summary: B2B HealthTech SaaS platform used by healthcare providers across 35 countries.
highlights: Designed UX for a healthcare platform used by 1000 clinics across 35 countries.
Launched an online treatment flow for 10K B2C patients.
Improved NPS from 37 to 54.
Integrated third-party modules, national labs, and Storybook-based UI components.
